query:
-- Molécules sans formule chimique, sans CAS, sans pubchem_cid (probablement descriptifs ou noms de plantes)
SELECT id, name, family, chemicalFamily, cas_number, pubchem_cid, smiles
FROM molecules
WHERE cas_number IS NULL AND pubchem_cid IS NULL AND smiles IS NULL
AND (
  name LIKE '%fumée%' OR name LIKE '%terre%' OR name LIKE '%bois%' OR name LIKE '%fleur%' OR
  name LIKE '%herbe%' OR name LIKE '%mousse%' OR name LIKE '%foin%' OR name LIKE '%cuir%' OR
  name LIKE '%miel%' OR name LIKE '%café%' OR name LIKE '%tabac%' OR name LIKE '%encens%' OR
  name LIKE '%résine%' OR name LIKE '%ambre%' OR name LIKE '%musc%' OR name LIKE '%vert%' OR
  name LIKE '%doux%' OR name LIKE '%frais%' OR name LIKE '%sec%' OR name LIKE '%chaud%' OR
  name LIKE '%Vetiver%' OR name LIKE '%Gaïac%' OR name LIKE '%Gaiac%' OR name LIKE '%Santal%' OR
  name LIKE '%Patchouli%' OR name LIKE '%Oud%' OR name LIKE '%Cèdre%' OR name LIKE '%Ciste%' OR
  name LIKE '%Benjoin%' OR name LIKE '%Labdanum%' OR name LIKE '%Myrrhe%' OR name LIKE '%Oliban%'
)
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 50;
